'''Philippe Parise DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Philippe Parise]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-11439">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11439 DeckTech post 11439], DeckTech (Philippe "Climax_Giver" Parise, 29 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11439/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11439/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018102059/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11439/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Philippe Parise]]
* '''Published:''' 29 October 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star|ANH-D-deathstar.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 DeathStar Parise DS 2000 11439.txt |Download]] (omits Grabber: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' this deck simple  get early activation &  get big stuff out to drian or pound.....a newbie style deck....but made to win

The post also lists 2x Grabber, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Original post ==

'''i got raped by vader    & i liked it'''
* '''Author:''' Philippe "Climax_Giver" Parise
* '''Published:''' October 29, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' this deck simple  get early activation &  get big stuff out to drian or pound.....a newbie style deck....but made to win

=== Strategy ===

ok......simple ......get merrejk out(he is a cmdr so piett can get him.....imp command can get piett) ......try & put him at dantooine because you can react there....& he will be safe from getting killed.....aslo get chiraneau once your systems are out& start draining with big punch....also get janust doing the recicle thing & make sure you put your high destiny in your deck & track hem well(if you can) also put the fear of monnock in them  from the start & play it only when you are going to get something out of it(used or lost) lateral damage is for that pesky canadian falcon.......or the homeone have fun raping asses with this one & make sure vader gets his fun
